economy.summary: His campaign introduction on the Mercer County Democratic Party's candidate page says he will fight for good jobs, fair wages, and economic opportunity for young people in the district.
economy.short: Says he will fight for good jobs and fair wages.

education.summary: Told a local newspaper that improving the public school system is among his campaign priorities; he has served three years on the Sharon City School Board.
education.short: Says improving the public school system is a campaign priority.

healthcare.summary: His campaign introduction on the Mercer County Democratic Party's candidate page says he will fight for affordable healthcare; it does not detail specific proposals.
healthcare.short: Says he will fight for affordable healthcare.

guns.summary: Lists community safety and criminal reform among his campaign priorities in a local newspaper interview; he has not stated positions on firearms specifically.
guns.short: Lists community safety and criminal reform priorities; no firearms specifics.

economy.summary: His campaign site says he enacted pro-growth policies that enabled the private sector to protect and create family-sustaining jobs.
economy.short: Says he enacted pro-growth policies supporting family-sustaining jobs.

taxes.summary: His campaign site says he passed fiscally responsible balanced budgets that did not increase taxes on working families, and that he opposed former Gov. Wolf's proposed tax increases.
taxes.short: Says he passed balanced budgets without raising taxes.

abortion.summary: Voted in July 2022 for Senate Bill 106, a package of proposed state constitutional amendments that included a provision declaring the Pennsylvania Constitution does not grant any right relating to abortion or public funding of abortion.
abortion.short: Voted for amendment declaring constitution grants no abortion right.

education.summary: His official House biography lists investing in the state's education system to build a brighter future for children among his priorities.
education.short: Lists investing in the state education system among priorities.

energy.summary: His campaign site cites securing funding to improve water quality, infrastructure, trails, and recreation facilities, and establishing a conservation coalition to protect ospreys; it does not state positions on energy policy.
energy.short: Cites water-quality and conservation funding; no stated energy policy.

guns.summary: Voted in May 2023 against House Bill 714, a bill reported as requiring background checks on all firearm sales in Pennsylvania; the bill passed the House 109-92.
guns.short: Voted against requiring background checks on all firearm sales.
